requirements.text: B.S. or above degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years proven experience building and maintaining high performance and scalable web services
Experience with service development
High fluency in data structures, algorithms, data modeling and schema design
Profound knowledge of web technologies and cloud services
Excellent coding skills in Java/Spring Boot, Kotlin or JavaScript
Hands-on experience with AI-supported software development tools, along with the capability to critically assess generated code, tests, designs, and technical recommendations.
Track record of designing and developing robust, scalable high impact cloud services
Proficient with large scale web application design and development guidelines to achieve modular, maintainable and extensible solutions
Ability to design reliable systems around nondeterministic components, including evaluation, validation, monitoring, fallback behavior, and failure recovery.
Operational experience running publicly available cloud services and applications, including AWS deployment/management services (CloudFormation, CloudWatch, etc.)
Comfortable both building prototypes from scratch and writing maintainable code inside large existing codebases
Shipped software in a commercial environment (start-ups a plus) and can deal with last-minute bug fixes and schedule changes
Strong product insight and the ability to transform unclear AI opportunities into testable hypotheses and measurable user outcomes.
Awareness of responsible AI considerations, including privacy, security, content safety, bias, provenance, and regional requirements.
Familiarity with model gateways, prompt and context management, structured generation, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, or vector search.
Experience developing evaluation harnesses for AI systems, including offline benchmarks, human evaluation, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring.
Experience with inference optimization, model routing, caching, rate limiting and AI cost management.
Familiarity with agentic or multi-turn AI workflows.
Experience with creative tools, digital media, content generation or creator-facing products.
Experience with DevOps and Agile/Scrum development practices.
